title: From a Village to the City
text:
Two years ago, Erkin moved from a small village near Turpan to Urumqi to study engineering. In the village, everybody knew each other, and life was slow and quiet. In the city, he didn't know anyone, and the noise and traffic were overwhelming at first.

The first months were the hardest. His flat was small and expensive, and his neighbours rarely said hello. He often felt homesick and called his parents every evening. However, he decided not to give up. He joined a football club at the university, and there he met other students who had also come from the countryside. They understood exactly how he felt.

Now Erkin gets along well with his classmates and knows the city much better. He still misses the fresh fruit and the open sky of his village, but he has also discovered things he loves about the city: libraries, museums and endless opportunities. He says that if he hadn't joined the football club, he might have gone back home.
